name: synaps-dash
description: synaps·dash: a sleek browser client for the synaps session daemon. Attach to live sessions as a peer of the TUI, with an album-reactive MXC palette, smooth streaming and a full motion system.
author: Jawz

config.description: Loopback port for the synaps·dash web UI (default 7717).
Telemetry store + /api/telemetry/* (on|off, default on). Reads local Synaps logs read-only; nothing leaves the machine.
Label for this machine's data in telemetry (default: the short hostname).
Extra read-only source roots, comma-separated host=path (e.g. jade=/path/to/snapshot).
